ship-ink.purpose: Solid cobalt cylinder barrel, with no stroked outline or label.

rocket.purpose: Fully opaque filled yellow flickering triangle, always visible.

ship-light.purpose: Flat upper highlight and front cap inset.

ship-shade.purpose: Rear elliptical end and lower barrel band.

motion.name: cut-hold
motion.purpose: A fresh cut retains its full shape before healing.

motion.name: cloud-healing
motion.purpose: Existing slow quintic closure, with eased live contours.

motion.name: automatic-engine
motion.purpose: Thrust applies exactly once in autoplay and player control. No thrusting boolean or Up throttle; Up/W takes over with automatic acceleration.

motion.name: shot-cadence
motion.purpose: Both control modes use a 45px blast radius, strength 7.5, and 900px range.

components.name: Artwork palette and cloud
components.description: Static tonal preview only; the live Canvas 2D contour remains the source of carving and healing behavior.

narrative.overview: This local direction applies only to the artwork in this folder. A flat blue sky carries rounded cartoon cumulus, with distinct white caps, pale bodies, and visible blue underside bands. The small ship is a solid blue can with an always-visible yellow rocket flame.
keyCharacteristics: Flat color fields with no cloud outlines.
Wide cumulus silhouettes with connected base scallops and filled white curls.
Carved sky channels remain clear through every painted layer.

rules.name: The Live Contour Rule
rules.body: Clip every painted cloud layer to the current carved silhouette. Decorative puffs cannot bridge a tunnel or join severed halves.

rules.name: Offscreen cloud reset
rules.body: Keep visible cuts; once the entire uncut cloud body is outside the viewport plus a 2px edge margin, clear cuts and eased contours and rebuild the intact cloud. Returning clouds are fresh.

dos: Do keep the underside visible on intact clouds and exposed lower cut edges.
Do preserve clear sky through the live carved channels.
Do retain the existing ship and cloud-boring behavior.
Do keep accessibility descriptions available without visible text.
donts: Don't add visible titles, captions, labels, counters, or instructions.
Don't outline clouds or add gradients, haze, or sky streaks.
Don't let decorative puffs fill a cut or bridge severed halves.
Don't apply this artwork palette to the gallery or issue interfaces.
